name: IRONWALL BOOK: Shelf Combat Odds Exchange S7
description: The Ironwall Book is the dominant odds-clearing operation for Shelf-level combat circuits, running parallel books on BLOODWORK bouts, independent cage matches, and the occasional sanctioned Tier 2 crossover fight. Operated out of rotating Shelf district nodes managed by the Gutwall Syndicate, the Book accepts payment in Quanta, raw chrome scrap, synth-protein credits, and favor debt. Its odds-compilers are considered some of the sharpest analytical minds on the Shelf, running predictive models built from injury data, augment registries, and informant networks.
story_hooks: A fighter's odds have been mysteriously suppressed for months despite an unbeaten record — someone wants her to lose, and the Book knows who.
A Tier 3 actuary moonlighting as an odds analyst for the Ironwall Book discovers a pattern suggesting a corponation is manipulating Shelf fight outcomes for insurance fraud purposes.
The Book's primary node is raided by Meridian Security, and the physical ledger — containing the names of every creditor, debtor, and favor-holder on six blocks — goes missing.
